_README: Which REAPER instrument stands in for each MainStage sound.
Every entry was checked against the plugins actually installed on this Mac
(REAPER's own scanned plugin lists) - nothing here is guessed.
'fx' is the name StageRig passes to TrackFX_AddByName. If it is null, the
track is still created, named and routed, but left empty and flagged so you
can drop your own choice in later. Nothing is silently substituted.
Edit this file freely - it is read at build time, not compiled in.

_probed_2026_08_03: Measured inside REAPER 7.28 by asking TrackFX_AddByName for each name
under every format prefix, not by reading a plugin list:
LOADS: Pianoteq 8, Omnisphere, BBC Symphony Orchestra, Kontakt 7,
SOLO (Taqs.im), ANA 2, Keyscape, Lounge Lizard EP-4
WILL NOT LOAD: Analog Lab V, Vital, Syntronik, GForce Axxess
Analog Lab V appears in REAPER's Audio Unit cache but cannot be
instantiated - scanned but not authorised, or needs a rescan. So there
is currently NO Hammond/B3 plugin available to REAPER on this Mac.
_installed_reference.organ_note: Until a real organ is installed, B3 parts are carried by Omnisphere, which has tonewheel/organ patches and definitely loads. This is a stand-in and is labelled as one. The proper fix is Arturia B-3 V (authorise the V Collection so Analog Lab V loads) or IK Hammond B-3X - then change the two organ rules below and rebuild.

Pianoteq 8.note: Exact match - the concert already uses this. No substitution at all.

Vintage B3.note: STAND-IN. Analog Lab V will not instantiate in REAPER on this Mac (probed, not assumed), so there is no real B3 available. Omnisphere has organ patches and loads reliably. Replace with Arturia B-3 V or IK B-3X when one is working.

Alchemy.note: Pads, synths, leads, sub bass. ANA 2 is the alternate that also loads here.

Sampler.note: Generic Logic Sampler fallback. Where the strip name says strings/horns/world, the name rules below win instead.

Studio Horns.note: Session-horns style library, loaded inside Kontakt.

Pedalboard.note: Organ drive/rotary - build it as a REAPER FX chain on the organ track instead of one plugin.

by_strip_name._README: Matched against the channel-strip NAME first (case-insensitive substring). More specific than the instrument map above, because the strip name is what actually says what the sound is.

choir.note: Omnisphere choir patch, or LABS Voices

shenai.note: Taqs.im SOLO - shehnai is exactly what this plugin is for

harmonium.note: Taqs.im SOLO, or a Kontakt harmonium

clav.note: Pianoteq clavinet model (the concert already used Pianoteq here)

organ.note: STAND-IN for B3 - see organ_note. Pick an organ patch in Omnisphere.

edm.note: Vital is installed but will not instantiate in REAPER here, so Omnisphere carries this.
